name: FitForge Core Food Dataset
license: Nutrient values derived from public-domain USDA FoodData Central (SR Legacy, FNDDS, Foundation Foods) family data, with typical-market values for composite/branded-style items. USDA data is in the public domain (CC0); this compilation is released under the repository license (CC BY-SA 4.0).
source_note: All values per 100 g edible portion. serving_grams is the default portion used when a user gives no quantity. household_measures map count/volume words to grams for the NL parser.
